name: Push-to-test indicator lamp
summary: A push-to-test indicator lamp allows a documented local test of the lamp circuit.
description: A push-to-test indicator lamp allows a documented local test of the lamp circuit. The test path and normal indication path must be distinguished.
readingNotes: A successful lamp test does not necessarily verify the monitored process contact.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Lamp test verifies an indication path; it is not automatically a complete alarm-system test.
